name: Butterfly Spy
source:
A fairy spy infiltrating a group of insurgents meets a handsome rebel. Will they choose their mission or their heart?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一名仙靈間諜潛入反叛者中間，遇上了一位英俊的反抗軍成員。間諜會選擇完成任務，還是聽從自己的心？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
